what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Tajikistan in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6420 Tajik asylum seekers, and the United States hosted 37.9% of them.
After the United States, the largest hosts are Kyrgyzstan, South Korea and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Tajikistan from 1995 to 1998, in 2000 and in 2010 and 2011.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan in 2021 and 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 635 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 7945, at the end of 2024.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
